meta.source: Cor v2 Supabase (anon REST, build-time read)
meta.note: Static decoupling layer. Page renders from this file, never a live query.

foundations.name: Domain-Sensitive Interacting Adaptations
foundations.statement: The organism contains evolved, domain-sensitive, interacting functional adaptations.
foundations.derivation: Tooby & Cosmides (design principle), confirmed empirically by Panksepp, Bowlby, Dunbar, Boehm, Trivers, Gilbert, Rozin.
foundations.scope_notes: "Organism" not "mind" - the immune system, HPA axis, circadian biology, gut-brain axis, thermoregulation are all evolved functional adaptations with environmental requirements. "Interacting" not "modular" - dense cross-system connections disprove informational encapsulation.

foundations.name: Recurrent Coupling and Cascading
foundations.statement: Systems are recurrently coupled; perturbations propagate and can self-maintain across domains.
foundations.derivation: Panksepp (cross-system inhibition) + Felitti (ACE dose-response) + Borsboom (network psychopathology) + McEwen (cumulative cross-system activation).

foundations.name: Competing Motivational Programs
foundations.statement: The architecture contains partially competing motivational programs and tradeoff structures.
foundations.derivation: Trivers (parent-offspring conflict, reciprocal altruism) + Boehm (dominance + anti-dominance) + Gilbert (approach + submit).
foundations.scope_notes: "Matched" does NOT mean "conflict-free." Matched vs mismatched = managed vs unmanaged tension.

foundations.name: Phylogenetic Priority
foundations.statement: Motivational programs have phylogenetically determined priority relations. Older, survival-critical systems can suppress or commandeer newer systems.
foundations.derivation: Panksepp (phylogenetic depth of affective circuits) + cross-species conservation evidence.

foundations.name: Socially Scaffolded Regulation
foundations.statement: Human regulation is constitutively socially scaffolded; social context is the highest-leverage cross-cutting input dimension.
foundations.derivation: Dunbar + Coan & Sbarra (social baseline) + Bowlby (attachment) + Hrdy (cooperative breeding).
foundations.scope_notes: Grade: forced for social modulation of regulation. Strongly supported for social context being the highest-leverage dimension. Given a cold virus in quarantine, adults with 1 to 3 types of social tie were about four times as likely to develop a cold as adults with 6 or more, step by step with the number of types (Cohen et al. 1997).

foundations.name: Defensive Over-Activation Bias
foundations.statement: Defensive systems err toward over-activation under asymmetric error costs.
foundations.derivation: Haselton & Buss (error management) + Nesse (smoke detector) + P1.

foundations.name: Systematic Mismatch
foundations.statement: Where modern environments depart from the conditions these adaptations evolved in, they push the adaptations outside their expected or regulatable operating ranges.
foundations.derivation: Eaton & Konner (discordance), Gluckman & Hanson (developmental mismatch), Li/van Vugt/Colarelli (mismatch review). Constrained by Boyd & Richerson / Henrich.
foundations.scope_notes:
Three modes - deprivation (expected inputs missing), conflict/overload (incompatible simultaneous demands), proxy hijack (false cues overstimulating systems). "Matched" means within the expectable range, often culturally scaffolded - NOT ancestrally identical in surface form. Modernity is mixed - it also brought sanitation, reduced violence, analgesia, literacy.

Grade: forced for the existence of systematic mismatch. Strongly supported for its scope.

foundations.name: Inclusive Fitness
foundations.statement: Inclusive fitness - survival and reproduction - is the loss function of selection, not of the organism's runtime computation.
foundations.scope_notes: The architecture exists because it contributed to the survival and reproduction of the organism and its genetic relatives across evolutionary time. The loss function explains why the mechanisms exist (ultimate). The mechanisms are how the loss function is implemented (proximate). No organism computes inclusive fitness explicitly - the mechanisms are proximate implementations shaped by selection. This is why proxies fail: they trigger input cues while failing to supply resolution conditions.

foundations.name: Defensive Signals Under Mismatch
foundations.statement: Where no clear physical defect is the cause, aversive outputs are intelligible defensive signals under mismatch, not evidence of defective design.
foundations.derivation: P2 + P3 + Nesse (negative outputs as defenses) + McEwen (reversible with environmental correction) + Birkett & Newton-Fisher (all 40 captive chimps studied showed abnormal behavior; none reported in wild observation).
foundations.scope_notes:
The line is a clear physical defect. The line is a stance, and Cor states it as one: it decides which cases Cor calls disease. It is never offered as an empirical result about foragers or any other population. Only a clear physical defect is a disease, whether a test has found it yet or not. Where such a defect is the cause (brain infection, autoimmune encephalitis such as anti-NMDA-receptor encephalitis, tumour, poisoning, a substance or medication effect, dementia or another neurodegenerative process, brain injury), it is the sole cause, the person is sick and the behaviour is a symptom of that disease. A defect that no test can find yet is still a defect. Large-effect genetic variants that cause measurable physical damage beyond the behaviour sit on the same side: the 22q11.2 deletion, for example, brings heart defects, immune deficiency and low calcium, and in about 90 percent of cases it arises new in the child (McDonald-McGinn et al. 2015). "Damage" in Cor means only a literal physical defect of this kind. A marker is something else. A receptor, a gene variant or a scan pattern that only shows how sensitive a person is to stimuli and to mismatch is no defect and no cause, and measured activation can itself sit downstream of mismatch. Where no defect is the cause, Cor uses no "disease" or "disorder" category: the output is a normal human response to a mismatched world. Inborn sensitivity, set by common genetic variation, decides how easily a person tips and how large the response is (DA10); common variants set sensitivity and cause no disease. Developmental calibration can set the threshold early (DA7), and recurrent coupling can keep a response running after its trigger has passed (DA3). Cor reads autism and ADHD traits without a physical defect of the kind above as normal heritable variation (DA10), with the distress and impairment coming from the setting the trait lands in. Persistence alone does not move a case across the line, and neither does a marker of sensitivity; a clear defect does. No label is carved out. Psychosis, bipolar and depression are each applied to cases on both sides, so a label settles nothing by itself. Cor's reading of psychosis where no defect is the cause: a signal with no resolution, turned all the way up. In a mismatched world most signals get no resolution, so they keep rising and stop looking like healthy signals. Where a signal gets its answer, as in the world humans lived in for most of their history, it is resolved long before it reaches that level. A withheld need does this to healthy people: kept from sleep in 21 studies of 760 people, they had perceptual distortions within one to two days, hallucinations after two to four days and delusions after three, and normal sleep ended the symptoms in many cases (ext 4020). The reading is Cor's position and carries no empirical grade. If a clear defect is found behind a subset of a label, that subset moves to the physical side. Rival readings: Nesse places psychotic depression and mania, which have no validated marker, in a separate class of broken mood regulation (ext 355, 358), and Keller & Miller read much heritable liability as mutational load (ext 590, 594). Both are arguments with no test of their own, and Cor applies the clear-defect rule.

Grade: forced for the qualitative claim that the output is a defensive signal. Strongly supported for its extent. The clear-defect rule sets the extent. The rule is a stance and carries no grade. Negative thoughts (project position, 21 Nov 2026). Negative thoughts are part of the signal and no separate cause inside the person. Low mood that points at something wrong in a person's conditions carries negative thoughts with it; without them it would not be low mood. Or they are what a person imagines in the absence of a real audience. In 998 adults followed for a year, those who later became depressed had shown no more negative thoughts beforehand, and the thoughts did not last after the episode (ext 4072). The shape of low mood follows its input: in 4,856 adults of a US population twin sample, losing a person brought sadness, loss of pleasure and appetite loss, while chronic stress and failure brought fatigue and oversleeping, and the same held within the same person from one episode to the next (Keller, Neale and Kendler 2007).

foundations.name: Fitness Interface
foundations.statement: Access to the world is mediated by evolved fitness interfaces, not guaranteed veridicality.
foundations.derivation: Hoffman (Interface Theory of Perception), Prakash et al. (Fitness Beats Truth theorem).
foundations.scope_notes: Everything experienced is a species-specific interface shaped by natural selection to track fitness payoffs, not truth. Cor operates entirely within this interface. OF1 does not enter the derivation chain - its function is to clarify that every mechanism output is a fitness-relevant signal by design, and to keep the door open to ontological questions outside the interface.

foundations.name: Market Proxy Exploitation
foundations.statement: Markets can industrialize proxy exploitation of unmet regulatory needs.
foundations.derivation: P3 + DA4 + market incentive structures + empirical (Moss food, Schull gambling, Haugen attention, Muldoon & Parke companion AI; children ate more after a single exposure to food adverts in the experiments pooled by Boyland et al. 2016).

foundations.name: Non-Substitutability of Mechanism Resolution
foundations.statement: Mechanism resolution conditions are not fully interchangeable. Improvement in one mechanism can buffer or modulate consequences in another, especially where mechanisms are recurrently coupled (DA3), but cross-system buffering does not generally replace the specific resolution conditions of an impaired mechanism. Well-being is often bottlenecked by severe unresolved deficits in individual mechanisms and is not well described as a simple average across mechanism states.
foundations.derivation: Follows from P2 (domain-sensitive interacting adaptations: if mechanisms are domain-sensitive, their resolution conditions are not freely interchangeable). Coupling and cross-system buffering effects are handled separately by DA3 (Recurrent Coupling and Cascading); DA9 specifically claims non-fungibility of resolution conditions, not absence of cross-system effects. Liebig's 1840 Law of the Minimum is the historical analogy for the bottleneck pattern.
foundations.scope_notes: Cross-system buffering findings count against a strong version of DA9 in which the most-degraded mechanism sets well-being: oxytocin effects on the HPA axis, exercise effects on sleep, meaning effects on illness coping. Cor reads them as coupling effects (DA3). They modulate the consequences of an unmet resolution condition and do not supply it. In Cor, partner touch and a mother's voice lower cortisol responses to a lab stressor (ext 429, ext 820). The exercise and meaning findings have no record in Cor yet. Among 33,391 employed US adults, more income went with less unhappiness for the least happy 15 to 20 percent up to about 100,000 dollars a year and then no further; the authors suggest the misery that remains, such as heartbreak and bereavement, is what income does not relieve (Killingsworth, Kahneman and Mellers 2023).

foundations.name: Allostatic Load Accumulation
foundations.statement: Chronic unresolved activation accumulates as allostatic load.
foundations.scope_notes: Allostatic load is physical and measured (cortisol, blood pressure, HbA1c, CRP and other markers; ext 128). In 822 Swedes followed from 16 to 43, adversity that threatened close relationships, added up over the years, went with higher allostatic load at 43 in women and men, independently of socioeconomic disadvantage (Gustafsson et al. 2012). Under the clear-defect rule (DA1), wear that has become a separate disease, such as type 2 diabetes or heart disease, sits on the physical side, and behaviour that disease drives is its symptom. An infection or another clear defect sits there too. Low-grade inflammation that a mismatched life produces (isolation, sitting, poor diet, broken sleep) is M8 responding: it is part of the response and stays on the response side, together with the low mood it drives. Raised markers alone do not move a case across the line: a marker of load or of sensitivity is no defect. The response that built the load stays a normal response. Much wear reverses when the mismatch is undone and the inputs are back toward the baseline rows. Some may not (telomere shortening, hippocampal volume loss).

foundations.name: Heritable Parameter Variation
foundations.statement: Architecture parameters (drive gains, thresholds, calibration setpoints) vary between individuals within heritable ranges.
foundations.derivation: Complements DA7: DA7 says the environment tunes the operating point, developmentally and ongoing; DA10 says the tunable ranges themselves differ per person, substantially heritably. Grounded by C15 triangulation across three independent method families: twin designs (Polderman et al. 2015 meta-analysis of fifty years of twin studies), adoption/family designs (Plomin program), and molecular SNP-heritability from unrelated individuals (Yang et al. 2010 GCTA line). Canonical framing: Turkheimer 2000 three laws of behavior genetics.
foundations.scope_notes: Heritability is a population statistic under a given environment distribution, not individual determinism: it describes variance partitioning within that distribution and says nothing about what a changed environment does to the population mean. DA10 therefore does not weaken P3 - mismatch shifts the whole distribution regardless of where an individual sits in it. Nor does it license trait fatalism, which would contradict DC1 reversibility. The underlying heritability findings are among the most replicated in the field (Turkheimer first law); the mapping from measured trait heritability to architecture parameters (gains, thresholds, setpoints) is Cor's architectural interpretation, and that interpretive step is why the grade is strongly_supported rather than the top confidence tier. Clear-defect rule (DA1): common genetic variants set sensitivity, meaning gains and thresholds, and cause no disease. A variant or a receptor that marks sensitivity is no defect. A large-effect variant that causes measurable physical damage, such as the 22q11.2 deletion, is a clear defect and sits on the physical side. Cor reads autism and ADHD traits without such a cause as normal heritable variation in these parameters, with the distress and impairment coming from the setting the trait lands in. Cor's position is that these traits carry advantages in a world that fits them. This is a reading: argued, not yet tested. The nearest record: in an online foraging task, US adults who screened positive for ADHD left depleting patches sooner and earned higher reward rates (Barack et al. 2024, ext 896, tested once). The other study usually cited measured body mass against DRD4 7R genotype in Ariaal pastoralist men and no behaviour or attention (Eisenberg et al. 2008, ext 853). For autism Cor holds no record. No study tests the traits in a world that fits them.

foundations.name: Proxy Hijacking via Open Loops
foundations.statement: Proxy cues can activate systems without meeting the conditions that normally regulate or terminate them.
foundations.scope_notes: Not all proxies fail equally. Resolution conditions must be independently specified, not inferred backward from proxy failure. Pictures and videos of food set off cue reactivity and craving that went with later eating and weight gain as strongly as real food did, across 45 reports and 3,292 people (r 0.33 overall; Boswell and Kober 2016). Drugs (project position, 21 Nov 2026). A drug hijacks, taking the place of other sources of reward, through how pure it is, how fast it reaches the brain and how much of it there is. Coca leaf chewed puts cocaine in the blood that peaks after about 23 minutes to two hours (ext 2525); the high of smoked cocaine peaks at 1.4 minutes (ext 2531). People who smoke or inject a drug are more often addicted than people who take the same drug by a slower route (ext 912, 914), and with a sedative at the same peak blood level, a faster rise gave more high and more wanting (ext 2530). Supply without limit is a hyperstimulus as well: betel sold ready-made for 5 to 30 US cents a quid, where 86 percent of current chewers met the authors' criteria for a use disorder (ext 2513, 2514); khat in tea-shops open day and night (ext 2527); cigarette tobacco with ammonia added, which frees the nicotine (ext 2534), against gum and patches that deliver it slowly and seldom turn into compulsive use (ext 2533). Plant drugs at plant strength, in the amounts a plant and a season give, are old (ext 899, 906, 2518), tobacco in the Americas was typically used in limited quantities (ext 2517), and are not the hijack. The line is drawn by purity, speed and quantity, never by a date: a pipe is a fast route and is thousands of years old (ext 906, 2516). Pituri in Central Australia was chewed mixed with wood ash, which frees the drug, almost without pause in a small-scale setting; no study measured what people gave up for it (ext 2519, 2520). Feeds (project position, 21 Nov 2026). A feed is a stand-in for company and standing among people who know you. What is missing does the harm, and the hours on a feed are not the measure: across 143 studies adolescents (ext 104), and the diaries of 17,247 adolescents show little link (ext 102). Quitting alone changes little, because it takes the stand-in away and puts nothing in its place: ten experiments found no significant effect on mood or life satisfaction (ext 2009), and the two largest paid experiments found small gains, in the first with more time spent with friends and family (ext 2006, 2008). Leaving alone costs: students wanted about 50 US dollars to give up TikTok or Instagram for four weeks while their friends stayed on, and 60 percent of the TikTok users and 46 percent of the Instagram users put a negative value on the platform when the question was its removal for their whole university (ext 2406). The harm shows when a whole group moves onto a feed: the arrival of Facebook at 775 US colleges raised an index of poor mental health by 0.085 standard deviations (ext 2031). College-bound US high school seniors spent an hour a day less with friends in person in 2016 than in the late 1980s (ext 2251). The medium is neutral: couples who met online stay together and rate their relationship as couples who met offline do (ext 1740, 1741, 2293).

foundations.name: Environment as Primary Intervention Layer
foundations.statement: Cortical override of subcortical activation is costly and tiring, and chronic defensive activation downregulates the cortical override machinery itself. Interventions that undo a mismatch, moving the organism's actual input conditions toward what it evolved for (the baseline rows of this atlas), are therefore more durable and less effort-dependent than interventions targeting cognitive override alone. The environment is a primary intervention layer for systemic and population-scale change, and is currently underweighted by major institutions.
foundations.derivation: Empirical corollary of DA8 (phylogenetic priority) + DA9 (non-fungibility of resolution conditions). DA8 + DA9 do not logically entail DC3 - they make environmental intervention a plausible higher-leverage path for systemic design, but the strength of the leverage is an empirical question. Supported by Sapolsky Forest Troop (N=1 troop, striking but limited generalization); Roseto Effect (observational, contested); Ilardi Therapeutic Lifestyle Change (author-reported response rates from a 2007 conference presentation and a 2009 trade book; no peer-reviewed RCT); BEIP foster care (single trial, large effect on reactive attachment disorder signs); captive-chimpanzee enrichment (variable but reproducible).
foundations.scope_notes: What counts as changing the environment (project position, 21 Nov 2026). Changing the environment means undoing the mismatch: moving a person's conditions toward what humans evolved for, as the baseline rows of this atlas state it. That is people around you who know you, in circles of about 5, 15, 50 and 150 (EEA-SOC-01), reciprocity and food shared among them (EEA-SOC-20), care for a child from many hands (EEA-CARE-01), standing given by people who know you (EEA-SOC-11), and the other rows. One question decides whether a change counts: did it make the person less mismatched? The form of the change decides nothing. A job, money, a move or a tool counts by what it supplies: a job can bring a role and people who need you, and money can end a threat. A little less mismatch is better than none. When a charity paid off the debts of poor households in Singapore, the share with the symptoms of generalised anxiety fell from 78 to 53 percent within three months (ext 1712). When a casino income lifted families out of poverty, their children's psychiatric symptom counts fell to the level of children who had never been poor, through fewer conduct and oppositional symptoms (ext 1315, 2243). Cash for poor households in low- and middle-income countries lowered depression and anxiety scores while it was paid; after the payments ended the gain was smaller and no longer statistically significant (ext 1311, 1312). A change that leaves a person as mismatched as before is nothing against this property when it does little: a lottery prize (ext 1713), a flat of one's own (ext 2842), programmes that arranged more chances to meet people (ext 2108). DC3 is a claim about leverage in systemic design. It does not compare treatments head to head. CBT, mindfulness-based interventions, CBT-I, and pharmacotherapy all have meta-analytic support. For medication Cor applies the clear-defect rule (DA1) and the medication line in A2: where a defect is the cause the drug may be treating a disease, and where none is the drug gets replaced by the real thing, such as people who need the person and give back. The real thing is hard to build under the influence, so the drug comes down while the real thing comes in. Tapering is not a rule for every medication. Where stopping suddenly is biologically dangerous, as with certain drugs and with alcohol, it is never stopped suddenly, and it is done with a doctor. Where no defect is the cause, the only imbalance is the one the drug makes, and what is called relapse after stopping is the original signal returning plus withdrawal. Open question: part of measured CBT efficacy may come from environmental scaffolding (therapeutic alliance, weekly attention, structured tasks that build agency). No study in Cor tests this. Drug habits (project position, 21 Nov 2026). A drug habit has two parts. It starts and stays as a stand-in for something missing (DA4), or it follows a purified drug supplied for months: of pain patients given high doses of opioids for 91 days or more, 6.1 percent got a diagnosis of opioid abuse or dependence within a year, against 0.004 percent of those given none (ext 2860), more often people with earlier mental health or substance diagnoses (ext 2861). The drug then changes the body in its own right: tolerance, withdrawal, and wanting set off by the places and people of use (ext 964, 969, 970, 973, 2533). That change is a physical effect of the substance (OF2). It is real, and it comes down: in methamphetamine users who stayed off the drug, dopamine transporters rose 16 to 19 percent between about 3 and 14 months (ext 2855). It does not decide whether the habit lasts: with the same body, use rose and fell with the setting. One in five US Army enlisted men leaving Vietnam in 1971 had become dependent on heroin or opium there (ext 2814); 12 percent of the men addicted there were addicted at any time in the three years after return (ext 2820), with heroin easy to get at home, though under 10 percent pure against 90 percent in Vietnam (ext 941). Long-term opioid users from San Antonio were abstinent 54 percent of the time while living elsewhere and 12 percent of the time at home, and on 81 percent of their returns while abstinent they were using again within a month (ext 2833, 2834). Neither study measured what the men lived among, so they show that the body's dependence does not decide, and nothing more. What the person comes back to decides (project position): people who know and need them, and a role among them (EEA-SOC-01, EEA-SOC-11). Rats trained on heroin or methamphetamine chose another rat over the drug almost every time, at any dose (ext 925). The drug comes down while the real thing comes in (A2). Where stopping suddenly is dangerous, as with alcohol and certain drugs, it is never stopped suddenly, and it is done with a doctor; after a stop the old dose can kill, because tolerance has fallen (ext 988, 2849). Portugal paid employers 80 percent of the wage and social security costs, for up to two years, of people in or after drug treatment (ext 2452); the report gives no figure for what that did to drug use. Open: after long access, housing and rank no longer changed how much rats drank (ext 933). In the California heroin cohort, the men who had not recovered more often had a spouse who also used drugs and lacked support from people who did not use, but stable recovery ten years on was predicted only by ethnicity, self-efficacy and psychological distress (ext 2838). Craving set off by cues goes with a later return to use (ext 2854); the meta-analysis analysed nothing of what the person came back to, so it is not counted against this position. Not studied: the home the Vietnam men came back to was not among the predictors analysed (ext 2816, 2820), Robins rejects the absence of the cues of use as the explanation (ext 2821), and Cor holds no study that put long-term users among people who need them. A job counts by what it supplies. Women in drug treatment in Baltimore who were given paid work, kept on condition of drug-free urine, gave cocaine-negative samples 54 percent of the time over three years, against 28 percent in usual care (ext 2454). In another trial a job of the same kind with no drug rule did less, 10 percent against 29 percent with the rule (ext 2455). What the work supplied beyond pay was not measured in either. Not counted against this position, because nothing in them brought the person people who know and need them: a flat of one's own (ext 2842) and the 2001 report on the same California men treated under compulsion, which measured nothing of where they lived (ext 2835). Costly and tiring (21 Nov 2026). Self-control is no measured drain on the body's energy: blood glucose did not fall in four short self-control experiments in people who had eaten (ext 5001), the brain uses about a fifth of the body's energy at a near-constant rate (ext 5007), and two tests in 23 and 36 laboratories found ego depletion near zero (d 0.04 and 0.06) (ext 4294, 4295). It is a cost all the same: people choose the option that asks less mental control (ext 4298), and after a workday of hard control work people chose easier and quicker options and had more glutamate in the lateral prefrontal cortex (ext 5013). In rats, chronic stress shrank the medial prefrontal cortex and the associative striatum, enlarged the sensorimotor striatum and turned goal-directed choice into habit (Dias-Ferreira et al. 2009). Telling people to use willpower added nothing: in two randomised field experiments, students told to resist distractions by willpower rated their success at a one-week study goal no higher than students given no strategy (Duckworth et al. 2016).

foundations.name: Developmental Calibration
foundations.statement: The architecture calibrates to developmental and ongoing environmental input within evolved ranges.
foundations.derivation: Bowlby (internal working models) + Hrdy + McEwen + Meaney (HPA-axis calibration).
foundations.scope_notes: BROAD life history theory rejected. NARROW architectural calibration (specific systems calibrate during specific windows) is forced. Across 54 studies of 116,010 children, threat such as violence went with earlier puberty and faster cellular aging, while deprivation and low income did not (Colich et al. 2020). Childhood and the adult (project position, 21 Nov 2026). What happened to a person as a child explains little of how they feel now; their genes and the world they live in now explain most. Across all traits measured in fifty years of twin studies genes account for 49 percent of the differences between people and the environment twins share for 17 percent (ext 637, 638). Adoptive siblings reared together correlate .04 in personality (ext 2880). With confounding by genes and family adjusted for in quasi-experimental designs, the link between childhood maltreatment and later mental health problems is 45 percent smaller (ext 1638); maltreatment on a court record and not recalled goes with no raised rate of diagnoses (ext 1640); recorded and recalled maltreatment agree poorly: about half of each group is missing from the other (ext 2888). Children of a parent diagnosed with depression who were adopted away were diagnosed with it 23 percent less often than their home-reared full siblings, 19 percent in half siblings (ext 2878): a modest effect, on a registered diagnosis, from a home they also lived in through adolescence. Attachment in infancy showed no significant link with attachment more than 15 years later (ext 2893). After a frightening event most people come through: 9.2 percent met the criteria for PTSD after an event drawn at random from their life (ext 2912). The exception is deprivation far outside anything a human child evolved for (C12). Children assigned by lot to foster care scored lower on general symptoms at 16 than children assigned to stay in institutional care (ext 2909). Romanian children who spent more than six months in an institution still had more problems at 22 to 25 in supportive adoptive homes, and those adopted before six months mostly did not (ext 2903). Open: brothers adopted away scored 4.41 IQ points higher at 18 to 20 than brothers reared at home (ext 2877); the adoptive family explained 14 percent of schooling and 33 percent of drinking among Korean American adoptees (ext 2872); in poor US families the shared home accounted for about 60 percent of IQ differences at age 7 (ext 2896); people diagnosed with PTSD show a raised heart rate at rest, with no reminder present (ext 2917); an earlier meta-analysis found attachment moderately stable over the first 19 years (ext 2892).

foundations.name: Signal-Default Epistemology
foundations.statement: Motivational-emotional outputs are treated as prima facie informative about the organism's regulated conditions, by default. The signal is read as information about input conditions and current state, not as noise to be suppressed. This is a diagnostic default, not a presumption of veridicality (OF1 stands). Reading the signal as information is no argument against relieving it. The default is displaced in two ways. A clear physical defect displaces it outright, whether a test has found it yet or not, and the output is then a symptom of that defect: acute organic disease or state shift (an infection or autoimmune disease, an endocrine disease such as a thyroid fault, delirium), structural damage, a large-effect genetic variant with measurable physical effects, and substance or medication effects. A setting left by deprivation far outside the evolved range (DA7) and chronic dysregulation displace the reading of the current input without making the output a disease: the output answers that setting, or a loop that keeps running, more than the present input. An ordinary hard childhood is no such setting, and even maltreatment, once genes and family are adjusted for, explains little of how an adult feels (DA7). Sleep loss and low-grade inflammation that a mismatched life produces also displace the reading of the current input without making the output a disease. A marker that only shows sensitivity is no defect. Chronic dysregulation counts as a physical cause only where a clear defect is behind it, such as an infection or another separate disease.
foundations.derivation: Frame layer, sibling of OF1. Methodological commitment that follows from P2 + DA1 + DA7: if the architecture is domain-sensitive (P2), and aversive outputs are intelligible defensive signals (DA1), and the architecture calibrates to developmental input (DA7), then the default reading of any mechanism output must be accurate to the environment the mechanism was calibrated for. Decoupling is the exception requiring evidence.
foundations.scope_notes: OF2 is a diagnostic default, not an ontological claim. OF1 establishes that perception is not guaranteed veridical at the fitness-interface level; OF2 establishes that motivational-emotional signals are read as informative about state and input conditions before being read as noise. Positive evidence sufficient to displace the OF2 default includes: time-locked onset coincident with medical illness, medication, or substance exposure; lab or neurological evidence of acute physiological perturbation; persistence of the output across environmental changes that would normally resolve a defensive signal; or gross loss of context-sensitivity that breaks the expected defensive logic. The statement splits the displacing conditions on the clear-defect rule (DA1). Acute organic disease or state shift, structural damage, large-effect variants such as the 22q11.2 deletion, and substance or medication effects sit on the physical side: each is a clear physical cause, found or not yet found, and the output is its symptom. A marker that only shows how sensitive a person is to stimuli and to mismatch is no defect, and measured activation can sit downstream of mismatch. A setting left by deprivation far outside the evolved range and chronic dysregulation displace the default reading of the CURRENT input without making the output a disease: a threshold set by such deprivation (DA7) or by heritable sensitivity (DA10), or a loop kept running by coupled systems (DA3), is still a response. Sleep loss and low-grade inflammation that a mismatched life produces (M7, M8) are part of the response, even when they are measured. Chronic dysregulation counts as a physical cause only where a clear defect is behind it, such as an infection or another separate disease. Persistence across environmental change and loss of context-sensitivity are reasons to look for a physical defect and to check calibration and coupling; by themselves they do not license a disease label.

mechanisms.name: Reproductive Motivation
mechanisms.eli5: Three components - desire, attraction, and pair bonding - that can work independently of each other. This system shapes much more of human behavior than reproduction itself.
mechanisms.description: Fisher's three-system model. Independent from M2 pursuit. HPG axis, not just brain circuits.
mechanisms.resolution_conditions: Sexual fulfillment within pair bond + pair bond stability + reproductive success.
mechanisms.mismatch_prediction: Pornography, dating apps, delayed reproduction, social media mate-value comparison.

mechanisms.name: Social Bonding
mechanisms.eli5: Forms bonds with other humans. Pain-grade distress when they're gone.
mechanisms.description: Attachment and co-regulation system. Includes grief mode (absorbed from old M9 GRIEF). Two states: security (enables broadly) and grief (suppresses broadly).
mechanisms.resolution_conditions: Reliable human co-regulation through physical presence, operating through nested social layers: ~5 intimate co-regulators (primary emotional/physical support), ~15 sympathy group, ~50 close social partners, ~150 coherent face-to-face relationships (Dunbar number - outer cognitive ceiling). Each layer represents qualitatively different relationship types with different obligations and investment requirements. The innermost ~5 provide the majority of social regulation; the critical variable at this layer is reliability, not count. The ~150 outer figure is an illustrative central tendency, not a hard limit: its derivation from the primate neocortex-ratio regression is contested (Lindenfors, Wartel & Lind 2021). What the evidence carries is the nested layering and the reliability-over-count point, not the exact rung figures; the layered structure and its low-hundreds clustering are separately observed in phone, Christmas-card, and Facebook data.
mechanisms.mismatch_prediction: Nuclear family, isolated living, mediated contact substituting for physical presence.
mechanisms.proxy_gradient: 5 levels (ordered by real co-regulatory function supplied, not amount of contact): reliable physically co-present inner circle (FULL) → real bonded inner circle held at a distance, remote contact (PARTIAL) → large mediated network routing only partly to real co-presence (MIXED) → one-sided parasocial attachment to a non-reciprocating figure (MINIMAL) → AI companion engineered to simulate a reciprocating bond (ZERO; EVIDENCED-theoretical on ext595). mechanisms.phylogenetic_age: ~165-200Myr (attachment, mammals); human layered network not dated

mechanisms.name: Status Monitoring
mechanisms.eli5: Constantly monitors where you stand relative to others.
mechanisms.description: Rank regulation. Shame, pride, submission, defeat, rank vigilance. Not optional - runs continuously.
mechanisms.resolution_conditions: Acceptable position in a bounded, personally-known reference group on the order of ~150 (an illustrative central tendency, not a hard number; the precise figure is contested per Lindenfors 2021). Earned prestige preferred over coerced dominance. Prestige and dominance are separate routes to rank (Henrich & Gil-White 2001, work 129; Cheng et al. 2013, ext 622). Among the Chabu, prestige predicted elected leadership more strongly than dominance (Garfield & Hagen 2020, ext 624). Among Tsimane men, both routes went with higher fertility, and prestige was the strongest path from status to fitness (von Rueden et al. 2011, ext 623).
mechanisms.mismatch_prediction: Global comparison via social media. Millions of "peers." Status-defeat cascade.
mechanisms.proxy_gradient: 5 levels (cue ≈ constant comparison/ranking signal; ordered primarily by real standing supplied in a real knowable group, with prestige>dominance quality folded in at the top): earned prestige in a small face-to-face group (FULL; EVIDENCED) → coerced/unstable dominance rank in a real group (PARTIAL; EVIDENCED) → status-striving in a large impersonal society (MIXED; EVIDENCED) → global mediated comparison by follower/like counts (MINIMAL; EVIDENCED: across 54 samples, upward comparison on social media went with more envy, shame, anxiety and depression symptoms and lower well-being, r about 0.33, Lei et al. 2026) → purchased status signals, luxury-brand display (ZERO; architecture-derived). The order of the two floor rungs (MINIMAL social-media comparison, ZERO purchased signals) is untested.

mechanisms.activation_note: Rank tracking runs continuously; not optional (see description).

mechanisms.name: Circadian Regulation
mechanisms.eli5: Synchronizes every system to the light-dark cycle. Master timing architecture.
mechanisms.description: SCN master clock. Gates metabolism, immunity, cognition, mood. The mismatch lies in timing more than in sleep duration. A week of natural light moved the body clock about two hours earlier while sleep duration stayed the same (Wright et al. 2013, ext 610, n=8). Social jetlag predicts overweight after controlling for sleep duration (Roenneberg et al. 2012, ext 92). Across 43 studies of 231,648 people, social jetlag went with higher body mass index and 1.2 times the odds of overweight (Arab et al. 2024).
mechanisms.resolution_conditions: Dark-cued sleep onset, bright daylight exposure, consistent rhythm.
mechanisms.mismatch_prediction: Electric light, blue screens, shift work, caffeine
mechanisms.proxy_gradient: 5 levels (Kind B: not a constant-cue hijack - the entraining light signal itself degrades and is finally inverted; ordered by per-individual signal degradation): outdoor light-dark cycle with dark-cued sleep (FULL) → indoor daytime light with a mostly-dark, dimly-lit night (ATTENUATED) → correctly-phased clock overridden by a misaligned social schedule / social jetlag (PARTIAL) → shift work and always-on connectivity with the dark cue largely gone (MINIMAL) → evening blue-light screens actively mis-setting the clock, false daylight at biological night (DEFEATED). All five EVIDENCED. Untested: the order of PARTIAL (social jetlag) and MINIMAL (shift work), and whether evening screens are the floor.
mechanisms.p1_basis: Survival (gates metabolism and immunity; shift work raises heart attack risk)
mechanisms.phylogenetic_age: ~500Myr+ (animal clock genes, insects and vertebrates); cyanobacterial clocks are older but a separate origin
mechanisms.activation_note: Sleep pressure (Process S) accumulates with time awake and discharges in sleep; the circadian clock gates timing.

mechanisms.name: Contamination Avoidance
mechanisms.eli5: Disgust system. Pathogen avoidance extended to moral/social contamination.
mechanisms.description: Three-domain disgust (pathogen, sexual, moral). Behavioral immune system.
mechanisms.resolution_conditions: Clean food, clean social environment, moral disgust contained.
mechanisms.mismatch_prediction: Moral disgust weaponized in politics, purity spirals.
mechanisms.proxy_gradient: 3-rung EVIDENCED pathogen-disgust gradient (FULL→PARTIAL→MIXED): clean food + clean social environment, disgust firing on real pathogen cues (FULL) → vulnerability-calibrated over-firing, e.g. pregnancy/immunosuppression (PARTIAL) → behavioral-immune smoke-detector false positives on harmless people (MIXED; floor). Moral-disgust extension, SPECULATIVE/CONTESTED and unordered: purity-coded social aversion and weaponized moral disgust (purity spirals). These are no rungs. Tybur et al. 2013 treat moral disgust as a separate adaptation that shares mainly its facial and vocal expression with pathogen disgust (ext 597, a theoretical framework). A meta-analysis of 50 studies finds that incidental disgust does not amplify moral judgment once publication bias is corrected (Landy & Goodwin 2015, ext 105, d=-0.01). The purity-spiral and dehumanization mismatch prediction rests entirely on this extension, the weakest evidence in M12. The same evidence makes the 'moral disgust contained' clause in resolution_conditions CONTESTED.
mechanisms.p1_basis: Survival (pathogen avoidance; a behavioural immune system)
mechanisms.phylogenetic_age: ~25-34Myr+ (contamination avoidance, Old World primates); parasite avoidance across animals has no single age
mechanisms.activation_note: Fires on contamination cues; silent otherwise.

mechanisms.name: Care / Alloparenting
mechanisms.eli5: Distributed care - the organism expects a village, not solo parenting.
mechanisms.description: Parental and alloparental care system. Oxytocin/prolactin circuits.
mechanisms.resolution_conditions: A distributed care network rather than solo or dyadic parenting. In forager societies people other than the mother hold and care for infants: Hadza allomothers do about 31% of the holding of infants under four (Crittenden and Marlowe 2008, ext 2128), and Efe infants are cared for by many people from birth (Tronick et al. 1987, ext 700). The critical resolving variable is the presence + continuity of real alloparental supply (care + provisioning), NOT bare kinship.
mechanisms.mismatch_prediction: Nuclear family without alloparental network. Parent burnout cascade.
mechanisms.proxy_gradient: Two scales. Axis A - real alloparental supply (empty-shelf/deprivation axis; ordered by caregiver count × continuity, NOT kinship): distributed kin-and-community network (FULL) → multiple reliable caregivers incl. high-quality paid care (REDUCED) → single intermittent helper / high-turnover institutional care (THIN) → solo/dyadic parent, no network (EMPTY SHELF; deprivation floor, not a proxy). Axis B - fake-fix proxy (real alloparental function ≈0 for both; ordered by completeness of the caregiver-OTHER counterfeit): screen/app babysitter → AI/robot 'caregiver' (ZERO; architecture-derived).
mechanisms.p1_basis: Reproduction (raising slow-maturing young needs more care than one mother can supply)

mechanisms.name: Movement / Regulatory
mechanisms.eli5: Movement isn't just exercise - it activates repair mechanisms throughout the organism.
mechanisms.description: Physical activity as zeitgeber, anti-inflammatory, mood regulator.
mechanisms.resolution_conditions: Movement that's part of daily life rather than set aside as 'exercise'. Hadza men walk about 11 to 13 km a day and women about 6 to 8 km, and the women also dig for several hours, all as a side effect of foraging (Pontzer et al. 2012 and Wood et al. 2021, GPS; ext 196, ext 3418; Hadza only).
mechanisms.mismatch_prediction: Sedentarism. Gym sessions as partial compensation.
mechanisms.proxy_gradient: 5 levels (Kind B: inverts the usual proxy story - the real input is withdrawn, not a false cue fired; ordered by how much of the all-day muscle-activity distribution is supplied): all-day incidental movement of foraging life, locomotion plus active rest postures (FULL) → a physically active job, farming/manual labour/walking-heavy trade (ATTENUATED) → mostly sedentary day broken up by walking, standing and fidgeting / incidental NEAT (PARTIAL) → sedentary day plus a discrete gym/exercise session, a partial re-supply not a false cue (MINIMAL) → chair-bound sedentarism with essentially no movement (DEFEATED). All five EVIDENCED. On a mortality axis the order of ATTENUATED and MINIMAL runs the other way: in 22 cohorts of up to 590,497 workers followed for 23 years on average, with each kind of movement adjusted for the other, movement at work went with no longer life than sitting work, while movement in leisure time went with lower mortality in both sexes (HR 0.75 to 0.87; Coenen et al. 2024). On a fitness or mortality axis MINIMAL (gym) and PARTIAL (incidental movement) could also swap; that order is untested.
mechanisms.phylogenetic_age: ~2Myr (human form, argued); older regulatory roles not dated
